contentMap.targetAudience: Professionals and enterprises creating high-quality visual content, including creative directors, video producers, art directors, marketing managers, and creative leads

hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
hero.supportingLine: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: Feature 1
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description:
Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs.
The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Capabilities of Seedream 4.5 by ByteDance
features.description: From accurate text rendering to consistent image editing and multi-image composition, Seedream 4.5 powers high-quality, professional visual creation with superior precision and control.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: Additional Feature
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description:
Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together.
Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Key Capabilities of Seedance 1.5 Pro
features.description: Seedance enables professional-grade AI video production with narrative coherence and realistic motion.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)
includes: Fast inference for quicker video production

referenceMap.heroPattern: Split, high-emphasis hero with brand/logo anchor, large headline, short supporting copy, and a compact bullet-value list. Primary visual treatment is text-led rather than image-led, with strong hierarchy and immediate trust cues above the fold.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Single-column hero followed by a lead-capture section, then modular product-feature sections. Content progresses from broad value proposition to deeper feature detail, using clear vertical stacking and progressive disclosure.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Utility-first content cards with simple borders or subtle surface separation, minimal ornament, and list-driven feature presentation. Cards prioritize dense information clarity over decorative visuals.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA is action-oriented and conversion-focused in the hero. Secondary CTAs are sparse or omitted. Later sections use localized demo/request actions to reinforce intent without cluttering the page.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: No pricing pattern present; the page is positioned as enterprise lead-generation rather than transactional purchase.
referenceMap.footerMode: Footer not represented in the provided reference; treat as non-core or minimal informational footer if needed.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Media is lightweight and functional, centered on logo/brand mark and occasional product imagery or illustrative panels. No heavy gallery pattern; visual support is secondary to copy and form capture.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Modular feature sections with a label, headline, descriptive paragraph, and a nested list of capabilities. Each section works as a self-contained narrative block and can support a CTA at the section level.
referenceMap.formPattern: Prominent lead form placed directly after hero content. Uses a card container, stacked fields, and hidden metadata inputs for tracking and routing. The form is a central conversion mechanism rather than a secondary utility.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, conversion-first presentation with no obvious motion system in the provided markup. If motion is added, keep it restrained and utility-based, such as subtle fade-in or none at all.
designNotes: Prioritize clarity, authority, and lead capture over storytelling flourishes.
Use strong typographic hierarchy with large headings and concise supporting copy.
Keep surfaces clean and mostly white with light segmentation.
Use list-heavy layouts for feature communication instead of dense paragraphs.

Use a centered floating lead-capture card with high contrast and minimal fields. Since the input has no form fields defined, treat this as a concise demo-request conversion panel with one primary CTA and supporting reassurance text.

features.alt: This video presents a calm and peaceful indoor setting, bathed in the warm glow of a sunset. The overall mood is serene and comfortable, with a static activity level. The visual style is pixel art, reminiscent of retro video games, giving it an artistic and nostalgic aesthetic. The room features a bookshelf filled with books, various potted plants, and a comfortable-looking armchair with a cute cat-face pillow. Sunlight streams through a large window, creating bright, warm-toned light patterns on the wooden floor. The color palette is dominated by oranges, yellows, and browns, with touches of green from the plants, creating a high-saturation, inviting atmosphere. tw-object-cover

This image depicts a dynamic, high-energy scene of a modern train traversing diverse weather conditions, representing four distinct seasons. The overall mood is dramatic and visually striking, showcasing the train's resilience. The setting is outdoor, featuring mountainous landscapes in various states: snowy peaks, barren rocks, and hazy desert. The visual style is realistic with a touch of artistic exaggeration to highlight the extreme weather. The emotional tone is powerful and adventurous, emphasizing journey and endurance. The central subject is a sleek, white and blue passenger train. The artistic style is photorealistic, with clear details in the train and surrounding environment. The color characteristics are highly saturated and varied, transitioning from cool blues and whites in the winter storm to warm oranges and yellows in the sunny and dusty desert scenes. The color palette shifts from blue and white to warm orange, yellow, and earthy brown tones. tw-object-cover

This video features a mysterious, sleek gray mannequin-like figure holding up a digital scoreboard at a sports stadium. The mood is calm and slightly surreal, with a bright, outdoor setting under a clear sky. The activity level is static, focusing on the mannequin and the scoreboard. The visual style is modern and realistic, with a subtle artistic touch due to the mannequin's appearance. The emotional tone is neutral, perhaps slightly intriguing. The main subject is the mannequin, dressed in a striped shirt, holding a black digital scoreboard displaying "11:22" in red LED lights. The background shows blurred stadium seating filled with an audience, suggesting a sporting event. The artistic style leans towards photorealism with a high-tech element. The color characteristics are cool tones, primarily grays, blues, and whites, with vibrant red highlights from the scoreboard. The color palette consists mainly of cool grays, light blue, and bright red. tw-object-cover

The overall color palette is light and inviting, creating a sense of comfort and sophistication. tw-object-cover

Desktop.notes: Use a strong colored hero background with white/light text per brand rules. Left column: brand/logo anchor, headline, subheadline, supporting line, primary CTA. Include compact bullet-value list from supporting line implications. Right column should remain minimal and text-supportive rather than image-led; if no media asset is available, use a stacked trust-proof module or model callout panel. Keep CTA pair space even though secondary CTA is absent; render only primary CTA if empty secondaryCTA is not provided.

Desktop.notes: Place directly below hero on light grey background. Render badges as pill chips using brand-tinted outlines. No social proof count provided; keep only the four badges. Maintain a centered horizontal row on desktop with even spacing and strong separation from hero.

Desktop.variantHint: centered compact lead form card with headline placeholder and concise field stack
Desktop.notes: ContentMap form is empty, but page strategy requires a lead-capture section. Build a minimal enterprise demo-request form block using system form components without inventing specific field labels in the plan. Treat as a structured placeholder for later content binding. Position as a centered card on a light surface after trust. Keep it visually distinct but not transactional.

Desktop.variantHint: single feature lead with supporting feature cards, 3-column grid on desktop
Desktop.notes: Use a section header block followed by a 3-column card grid. First card should act as a lead feature summary with the long description. Remaining cards are feature list items. Use utility-first white cards with thin borders and simple icons or icon areas, consistent with design system. Keep prose concise and scannable. Emphasize image generation, editing, multi-image composition, text rendering, high resolution, and structural fidelity.

Desktop.variantHint: single feature lead with supporting feature cards, 3-column grid on desktop
Desktop.notes: Mirror the previous feature section for rhythm consistency. Present the lead summary card first, then the capability cards. Keep the structure parallel for easy comparison between the image model and video model. Highlight audio-video synchronization and cinematic control prominently.

Desktop.notes: Render as an enterprise pricing/quote section rather than checkout. Use two cards with the second card showing the only explicit price value. The first plan should show empty price state handled gracefully as 'Contact sales' or blank value placeholder in the design system binding. Include includes checklist, CTA button, and required pricing card hierarchy. Do not create a cart metaphor beyond the existing pricing card pattern.

Desktop.notes: Use the 5 testimonials in a 3-column desktop grid with 2 rows; if needed, keep the fifth card spanning or start a second row with balanced spacing. Each card must have gold star row, italic quote, bold author, and muted designation/company line. Keep left border accent per design system. Ensure quotes remain readable and do not overfill cards.

Desktop.variantHint: simple centered CTA band using extras.copy
Desktop.notes: Use the extra line 'Transform ideas into visuals instantly.' as a short closing reinforcement block before footer. Keep it lightweight and not introduced as a new marketing section. No additional CTAs are required if not supported by source. Footer follows as a minimal end cap.
Represent the footer as a minimal closing frame only. Do not invent navigation links or legal blocks in the plan. Keep it as a structural end cap for the single-page layout.

Mobile.notes: On mobile, stack all hero content vertically with text first because no image is required. Keep the headline size controlled for readability and preserve the primary CTA as full-width. Trust badges should become wrapped chips or a two-row compact list below the hero copy.

Mobile.notes: Convert badge row into wrapped chips with consistent gaps. No customer count or social proof element exists, so do not add one. Keep the block tight to avoid excessive fold depth.

Mobile.notes: Use the same form placeholder strategy as desktop, but make the card full-width and remove shadow per mobile rules. Inputs should stack vertically with the CTA last and full-width. Keep labels and fields generic until bound later.
